acceptanceCriteria: Either receipt admission for the Ruby provider document (exec prefix and inclusion lines bound) or --exec-prefix plus path mapping in the runner rspec profile, so a containerised RSpec run yields an admitted receipt identifying each shared-example inclusion; spec amended; tests.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1333. runnerAdmission corvint-test-runner/0 only admits corvint-test-runner documents; its rspec profile cannot run in a container without a path-preserving wrapper; corvint-ruby-test-provider supports --exec-prefix and shared-example inclusion lines but its document is not admitted.
title: No path from the Ruby test provider report to CEM runner receipt admission
